name: krita_layer_transform
description: Move, scale, rotate or shear a paint layer or group, one operation per call; the whole canvas is checked against protection and a leak is undone, and krita_history_step moves the call's undo steps together. translate moves by whole pixels through a transform mask on top of its masks, so the layer's own pixels never change: the first adds the mask, then moves it (two undo steps), a later one moves the same mask (one). A KRA keeps the move; an ORA drops it, so an ORA save is refused. scale, rotate and shear resample the layer and every layer in it about its bounds' centre, in one undo step; resampling loses detail, so copy the layer first (krita_layer_duplicate) to keep the original. They take only paint layers and groups of them: a mask, a locked or styled layer, a clone's source and a transform mask (scale, rotate or shear before translating) are refused, and the selection does not limit them. Refused for a protected layer or one holding one (translate: or in a protected group), and under Krita's cumulative undo. Duplicate a layer before translating it: a translated layer is not copied.

by_px.description: [x, y] in whole canvas px, each -16384 to 16384 and not both 0, added to the layer's translation.

size_px.description: [width, height] in whole px, each 1 to 16384: the new size of the layer's bounds, about their centre; past 8192 x 8192 in all is refused as too large. The bounds after may differ by a pixel where an edge is soft.

filter.description: Bicubic, the default, or another of Krita's resampling filters.

degrees.description: Degrees, -360 to 360 exclusive and not 0; positive turns clockwise on screen, about the bounds' centre. Krita resamples with Bicubic.

[x, y] in degrees, each -45 to 45 and not both 0, about the bounds' centre: a positive x moves rows below the centre right, a positive y moves columns right of it down. Krita resamples with Bilinear; a shear too small to move an edge by a pixel is refused.

created_mask.description: Whether this call added the transform mask.

translation_px.description: The layer's whole translation after the call. Paint on the layer lands where it is aimed, in the layer's own pixels, and shows moved by this; so do a paint receipt's changed_bounds_px and layer_bounds_px, which stay in the layer's own.

pivot_px.description: The centre of the layer's bounds before the call, which the operation keeps in place.

bounds_after_px.description: The layer's bounds after the call; for a group, its shown layers'.
